# mlp_v2 — generated by `a3bx3.mlp`; do not edit by hand

Small PyTorch MLP on the same outer folds as metrics_v2; other models' out-of-fold predictions are read from reports/oof_predictions.csv, not recomputed. MAE in eV with paired bootstrap 95 % CIs over formulas. Verdict per the rule pre-registered in reports/mlp_expectations.md.

Pre-registered rule: `reports/mlp_expectations.md` (commit `e153c25170fcb9da264ce9f12d3fd35ed5a49b56`).
